AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) je opti: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) optimizes your website and content so AI systems can understand, cite and potentially recommend you. Unlike traditional SEO, which competes for positions among search links, AEO makes content easier to understand and suitable for direct answers. SEO, AEO and GEO cannot guarantee rankings or AI recommendations.
